tiers.name: Pay per call
features: realestate_deal_memo: property record + value estimate + rent estimate + underwriting + memo
realestate_lookup: one RentCast record (property, value or rent)
sample=true returns a realistic example at no charge
every response carries data, sources, as_of, confidence, notice

lifecycle.reason: Paused, not retired. It needs a property-data API key to answer a real address at all, and until it has one the paid routes refuse rather than charging for a fixture. Nothing further is being built until there is a reason to.

sample_mode: pass sample=true on any tool or endpoint: no key, no charge, no model call
payment_methods: prepaid_credits (self-serve: POST /v1/keys, fund by card, no signup)
x402 (USDC on Base) — live, settles with no account and no human
upstream: RentCast (resale permitted under its API terms); cached per address for at most 24h
notice: Not financial advice. Automated estimates; verify independently.
